name: area-chart
title: Area Chart
description: Hand-written SVG area chart with monotone or linear curves, multi-series data and pointer tooltip.
docs: Pass either a single values number array or tabular data rows with categories and index. Monotone curves preserve local extrema without overshoot, and hover scrubs a vertical crosshair with condensed tabular values.
